id: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004)

facts.text: Have some chocolate, Harry. It helps after a Dementor. I'm Professor Lupin, by the way.
facts.why: Lupin does drive off the Dementor on the train and give Harry chocolate, but I could not open a quote page that proves these exact words. The line looks stitched together from several places.
facts.fix: Eat the chocolate, Harry. It helps after a Dementor.

fix_note.text: Eat the chocolate, Harry. It helps after a Dementor.

facts.why: No butterbeer foam moustache scene shows in the transcript or plot. The transcript does have Harry telling Hermione 'Good punch' after she hits Malfoy.

vibe.verdict: A cosy inn menu with the right touches (chocolate, Knight Bus, Honeydukes), but the picture is a small poster in a big frame and the film's best gags are missing.
missing: Hermione's Time-Turner saving Buckbeak and Sirius
The Marauder's Map handed back by Lupin
Harry sneaking into Hogsmeade and overhearing at the Three Broomsticks
Scabbers revealed as Pettigrew in the Shrieking Shack
Lupin transforming under the full moon
Draco provoking Buckbeak in Hagrid's first class
ideas: Swap 'Hogsmeade sweet shop coconut ice' for 'Honeydukes' secret passage toffee' to use the tunnel under the Whomping Willow.
Replace 'Tea leaf reading biscuits' note with a Divination line to use Trelawney.
Fill the poster frame, which has black bars top and bottom, with a still of the Knight Bus.
